sheets.label: FOR WHEN THE WORDS HAVE GONE
sheets.intro: Print, cut out, and keep them wherever you'll actually reach for them — a wallet, a phone case, or a standard lanyard card holder. They're sized to fit one. Laminating makes them last; a hole punch in the corner puts them on a keyring.
sheets.note: CUT ALONG THE OUTLINES · 85 × 54 MM · FITS A STANDARD LANYARD SLEEVE

cards.title: I can't speak right now.
cards.sub: I can hear and understand you. Please give me a moment — I'm not ignoring you.

cards.title: Please could you help me find something?
cards.sub: I'll show you on my phone, or point.

cards.title: Is there somewhere quieter I can sit?
cards.sub: Just for a few minutes. I'll be alright.

cards.title: Please could you write that down?
cards.sub: I process written words far better than spoken ones.

cards.title: I need to leave now.
cards.sub: Nothing is wrong with your service. Please let me past.

sheets.label: SHEET TWO — EXPLAINING AND EVERYDAY
sheets.note: YOU DON'T NEED A DIAGNOSIS, OR ANYONE'S PERMISSION, TO USE THESE

cards.title: Please don't touch me.
cards.sub: Not personal — touch is painful for me right now.

cards.title: Please speak slowly and quietly.
cards.sub: Short sentences help. One question at a time.

cards.title: I'm not being rude.
cards.sub: I'm overloaded. This is what it looks like for me.

cards.title: I need a moment before I answer.
cards.sub: Silence means I'm processing, not refusing.

cards.title: I'm autistic.
cards.sub: You don't have to do anything differently unless I ask.

cards.title: I have ADHD.
cards.sub: I may need instructions repeated or written down.

cards.title: Please phone this person for me.
cards.sub: Their name and number are on my contact card.

cards.title: I've already paid.
cards.sub: The receipt is on my phone — one second.

sheets.label: SHEET THREE — YOURS TO FILL IN
sheets.note: WRITE YOUR OWN IN THE SAME SHAPE — BIG WORDS, ONE MESSAGE PER CARD

cards.title: My name is
cards.sub: Best way to communicate with me:

cards.title: If I need help, please contact
